description: List asset risk assessment history. Shows risk scores, condition scores, and trigger events over time. Condition scores are 0-100: 85+ Excellent, 70-84 Good, 55-69 Fair, 40-54 Poor, below 40 Critical.

page.description: Page number (default: all pages fetched automatically)

per_page.description: Items per page (default: 1000, max: 1000). All pages are fetched automatically.
